newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not well established, compared with Friday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow and demand moderate. Seller interest light. Offerings light.
Steers - Select and Choice 2-4 no sales. Heifers - Select and Choice 2-4 1075 ld low dressing 68.00.
Carcass Basis (weight only) compared with Friday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were not well established.
